content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for VNSGU Temporary Assistant Professor / Temporary Teaching Assistant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced by VNSGU?
faq.answer: VNSGU has announced a total of 3 vacancies for the posts of Temporary Assistant Professor / Temporary Teaching Assistant.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 17 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess an MCA/M.Sc(IT)/M.Sc.(ICT)/M.Sc.(CA)/M.E.(Comp. Engineer)/(I.T.)/AI or equivalent Post Graduate Degree. NET/SET/Ph.D. is preferred for TAP.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 48,000/- per month for Temporary Assistant Professor and Rs. 40,000/- per month for Temporary Teaching Assistant.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for VNSGU recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Veer Narmad South Gujarat University, University Campus, Post: Udhna, Magdalla Road, Surat - 395007, Gujarat.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, these are temporary positions on a contract basis.
